steps: Opened each final screenshot as an image, at its supplied resolution.
Inspected names, selected lot, source/limit text where visible, buttons and result-table presentation.
Compared the two mobile table positions for medical/weapon results and the closed Observer message.
Matched every opened image hash to both its current file and its successful run report; excluded all failed-attempt captures.

findings.text: Lot3 is labelled122 references. The selected Brooks/Vindicator/Cerberus turret examples keep their partial-prototype, edition and generic-budget explanation visible. The captured medical example links its actual manual and distinguishes demonstrated values from the documented principle.

Four-column actor/weapon/enemy results remain readable. The medical bench shows five labelled columns and coherent rows:1→0 doses,2 revived test actors,0→36/54 health, conscious witness70 unchanged, excluded witness0 unchanged and medic ATB100→0.

The medical and weapon result tables avoid letter-by-letter header wrapping and split numeric/resource tokens. Their columns extend beyond one mobile viewport; left/right captures show access through the intended local horizontal scroll while the surrounding card remains within the viewport.
The mobile Observer reference visibly states its conditional allegiance and consultation-only closure; the disabled trial button is present.

evidenceLimits: This is a bounded review of38 viewport captures, not all122 entire cards or all scroll positions.
The review certifies neither original artistic likeness, animation quality, complete kits, original weapon values nor1:1 fidelity. No new character/armour/fleet art is supplied by these screenshots.
This set uses standard text size. Large text, gamepad input, original-game source matching, Electron launch and phone-device performance are not visually tested by this review.
The initial medical table header-wrapping failure belongs to its archived attempt. Only final successful-run images are included here.
Source-quality limitations and the exact boundaries of the two primary manual pages are described independently in expansion3-source-review.json.
verdict: No presentation defect observed within these38 final screenshots after the targeted mobile header fix. This verdict is restricted to the displayed prototype UI and stated viewports.
